records.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) AS unique_customer_count
FROM customers

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT seller_id) AS seller_count
FROM sellers

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_volume
FROM orders
WHERE order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_products
FROM products

SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.review_score >= 4) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 4) AS positive_review_rate
FROM reviews r
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = r.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')

SELECT AVG(r.review_score) AS avg_review_score
FROM reviews r

SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.freight_value), 2) AS total_freight
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')

SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS total_revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_category_name) AS category_count
FROM products p

SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.review_score <= 2) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 4) AS negative_review_rate
FROM reviews r
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = r.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')

SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.price) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) AS aov
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_state) AS state_count
FROM customers

SELECT ROUND(
    SUM(p.payment_value) FILTER (WHERE p.payment_type = 'credit_card') / SUM(p.payment_value),
    4
) AS credit_card_ratio
FROM payments p
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = p.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')

SELECT ROUND(AVG(DATE_DIFF('day', o.order_purchase_timestamp, o.order_delivered_customer_date)), 2) AS avg_delivery_days
FROM orders o
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
  AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL

SELECT ROUND(MAX(payment_value), 2) AS max_payment_value
FROM payments

SELECT ROUND(MAX(oi.price), 2) AS max_single_item_price
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')

SELECT 
    MIN(order_purchase_timestamp) AS earliest_order,
    MAX(order_purchase_timestamp) AS latest_order
FROM orders

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS canceled_orders
FROM orders
WHERE order_status = 'canceled'

SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) AS avg_items_per_order
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS delivered_orders
FROM orders o
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'

SELECT ROUND(AVG(freight_total), 2) AS avg_freight_per_order
FROM (
    SELECT o.order_id, SUM(oi.freight_value) AS freight_total
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
    GROUP BY o.order_id
) t

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_reviews
FROM reviews

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS distinct_orders_with_reviews
FROM orders o
JOIN reviews r ON r.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')

SELECT c.customer_state,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT ct.product_category_name_english AS category,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN category_translation ct ON ct.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT ct.product_category_name_english AS category,
       COUNT(*) AS item_volume
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN category_translation ct ON ct.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY item_volume DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT c.customer_state,
       ROUND(AVG(r.review_score), 2) AS avg_review_score
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN reviews r ON r.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY c.customer_state
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) > 100
ORDER BY avg_review_score ASC
LIMIT 3

SELECT c.customer_city,
       COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id) AS unique_customer_count
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY c.customer_city
ORDER BY unique_customer_count DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT s.seller_id,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN sellers s ON s.seller_id = oi.seller_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY s.seller_id
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT ct.product_category_name_english AS category,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.review_score <= 2) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS negative_rate
FROM reviews r
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = r.order_id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN category_translation ct ON ct.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY 1
HAVING COUNT(*) > 100
ORDER BY negative_rate DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT p.payment_type,
       COUNT(*) AS payment_count,
       ROUND(SUM(p.payment_value), 2) AS total_amount
FROM payments p
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = p.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY p.payment_type
ORDER BY total_amount DESC

SELECT c.customer_state,
       AVG(DATE_DIFF('day', o.order_purchase_timestamp, o.order_delivered_customer_date)) AS avg_delivery_days
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.customer_state
ORDER BY avg_delivery_days DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT ct.product_category_name_english AS category,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN category_translation ct ON ct.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  AND c.customer_state = 'SP'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT ct.product_category_name_english AS category,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.price) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) AS aov
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN category_translation ct ON ct.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY ct.product_category_name_english
ORDER BY aov DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT ROUND(
    COUNT(*) FILTER (cnt >= 2) * 1.0 / COUNT(*),
    4
) AS repurchase_rate
FROM (
    SELECT c.customer_unique_id,
           COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS cnt
    FROM customers c
    JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
    GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
) t

SELECT c.customer_state,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_volume
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY order_volume DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT s.seller_id,
       COUNT(*) AS negative_review_count
FROM reviews r
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = r.order_id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN sellers s ON s.seller_id = oi.seller_id
WHERE r.review_score <= 2
  AND o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY s.seller_id
ORDER BY negative_review_count DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT c.customer_state,
       AVG(DATE_DIFF('day', o.order_purchase_timestamp, o.order_delivered_customer_date)) AS avg_delivery_days
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.customer_state
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) > 100
ORDER BY avg_delivery_days ASC
LIMIT 3

SELECT ct.product_category_name_english AS category,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.freight_value) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) AS avg_freight_per_order
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN category_translation ct ON ct.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY ct.product_category_name_english
ORDER BY avg_freight_per_order DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT c.customer_state,
       ROUND(SUM(p.payment_value) FILTER (WHERE p.payment_type = 'boleto') / SUM(p.payment_value) * 100, 2) AS boleto_payment_ratio
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY c.customer_state
ORDER BY boleto_payment_ratio DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT c.customer_unique_id,
       COUNT(*) AS item_count
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
ORDER BY item_count DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT ct.product_category_name_english AS category,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.freight_value) / SUM(oi.price), 2) AS freight_ratio
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN category_translation ct ON ct.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY freight_ratio DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT s.seller_id,
       ROUND(AVG(r.review_score), 2) AS avg_review_score
FROM sellers s
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id
JOIN reviews r ON r.order_id = oi.order_id
GROUP BY s.seller_id
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 50
ORDER BY avg_review_score DESC
LIMIT 3

WITH review_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        ct.product_category_name_english AS category,
        COUNT(r.review_id) AS total_reviews,
        COUNT(r.review_id) FILTER (WHERE r.review_comment_message IS NOT NULL AND r.review_comment_message != '') AS text_reviews
    FROM reviews r
    JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = r.order_id
    JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    JOIN category_translation ct ON ct.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
    WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
    GROUP BY ct.product_category_name_english
    HAVING COUNT(r.review_id) > 100
)
SELECT 
    category,
    ROUND(text_reviews * 1.0 / total_reviews, 4) AS text_review_ratio
FROM review_stats
ORDER BY text_review_ratio DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT ct.product_category_name_english AS category,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN category_translation ct ON ct.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2018-01-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2019-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 5

WITH state_payment AS (
    SELECT 
        c.customer_state,
        p.payment_type,
        SUM(p.payment_value) AS total_payment_value
    FROM payments p
    JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = p.order_id
    JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
    GROUP BY c.customer_state, p.payment_type
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_state,
        payment_type,
        total_payment_value,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_state ORDER BY total_payment_value DESC) AS rn
    FROM state_payment
)
SELECT 
    customer_state,
    payment_type,
    ROUND(total_payment_value, 2) AS total_payment_value
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY customer_state

SELECT c.customer_state,
       ROUND(AVG(DATE_DIFF('day', o.order_purchase_timestamp, o.order_delivered_customer_date)), 2) AS avg_delivery_days
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
  AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.customer_state
ORDER BY avg_delivery_days DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp)::DATE AS month,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2018-01-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2019-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS year,
    ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2017-01-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2019-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp)::DATE AS month,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_volume
FROM orders o
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2018-01-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2019-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_volume
FROM orders o
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2018-07-17'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp <= DATE '2018-10-17'

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp)::DATE AS month,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2017-10-17'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp <= DATE '2018-10-17'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp)::DATE AS month,
       ROUND(AVG(r.review_score), 2) AS avg_review_score
FROM orders o
JOIN reviews r ON r.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2017-01-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2019-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('year', o.order_purchase_timestamp)::DATE AS year,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2018-04-01' THEN 'Q1'
        WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2018-04-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2018-07-01' THEN 'Q2'
    END AS quarter,
    ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2018-01-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2018-07-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

WITH first_order AS (
    SELECT c.customer_unique_id,
           MIN(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS first_purchase
    FROM customers c
    JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
    GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
)
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', first_purchase)::DATE AS month,
       COUNT(*) AS new_customers
FROM first_order
WHERE first_purchase >= DATE '2018-01-01'
  AND first_purchase < DATE '2019-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

WITH revenue_by_year AS (
    SELECT
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS year,
        SUM(oi.price) AS revenue
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
      AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2017-01-01'
      AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2019-01-01'
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
    ROUND(((r2018.revenue - r2017.revenue) / r2017.revenue) * 100, 2) AS growth_rate_pct
FROM
    (SELECT revenue FROM revenue_by_year WHERE year = 2017) r2017,
    (SELECT revenue FROM revenue_by_year WHERE year = 2018) r2018

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp)::DATE AS month,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_volume
FROM orders o
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2018-04-17'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp <= DATE '2018-10-17'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC('quarter', o.order_purchase_timestamp)::DATE AS quarter,
    ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT DAYNAME(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS day_of_week,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_volume
FROM orders o
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY order_volume DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS hour_of_day,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_volume
FROM orders o
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY order_volume DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH monthly_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp)::DATE AS month,
        SUM(oi.price) AS revenue
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
      AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2018-08-01'
      AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2018-10-01'
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
    ROUND(
        (MAX(CASE WHEN month = DATE '2018-09-01' THEN revenue END) 
         - MAX(CASE WHEN month = DATE '2018-08-01' THEN revenue END))
        / MAX(CASE WHEN month = DATE '2018-08-01' THEN revenue END) * 100,
        2
    ) AS pct_change
FROM monthly_revenue

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp)::DATE AS month,
       ROUND(AVG(DATE_DIFF('day', o.order_purchase_timestamp, o.order_delivered_customer_date)), 2) AS avg_delivery_days
FROM orders o
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2018-01-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2019-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp)::DATE AS month,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2017-01-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2018-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter', o.order_purchase_timestamp)::DATE AS quarter,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2017-01-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2018-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

WITH review_data AS (
    SELECT 
        r.review_score,
        o.order_purchase_timestamp
    FROM reviews r
    JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = r.order_id
    WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
),
recent_year AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE review_score >= 4) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS good_rate
    FROM review_data
    WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2017-10-17'
      AND order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2018-10-18'
),
previous_year AS (
    SELECT 
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE review_score >= 4) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS good_rate
    FROM review_data
    WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2016-10-17'
      AND order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2017-10-17'
)
SELECT 
    'recent_year' AS period,
    ROUND(recent_year.good_rate, 4) AS good_review_rate
FROM recent_year
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'previous_year' AS period,
    ROUND(previous_year.good_rate, 4) AS good_review_rate
FROM previous_year

WITH yearly_category_sales AS (
    SELECT
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS year,
        ct.product_category_name_english AS category,
        ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS revenue,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) ORDER BY SUM(oi.price) DESC) AS rn
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    JOIN category_translation ct ON ct.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
    WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
      AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2017-01-01'
      AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2019-01-01'
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT year, category, revenue
FROM yearly_category_sales
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY year, rn
